brill.welcome_heading: Welcome to IMPACT the online proofing tool for collaborating on proofing journal content for BRILL.
brill.instructions_body:
• Log in to Impact in a single browser window at a time (but if you would like your co-authors to review the article as well, please share it with them by selecting the sharing option in Impact).
  • Review your proof carefully, making any necessary amendments directly into the article.
  • Save your changes if you want to pause reviewing and use the logout option before closing the browser window. You may log in again later to resume reviewing using your log-in link.
  • Only finish your review in Impact when you are sure you have no additional changes to add as the review will be closed and not be accessible after reviewing has been completed.
  • Note that the images in IMPACT are low resolution to optimise the performance of the tool.
  • Submit the article when you have reviewed the entire article and resolved all author queries.
  • You will receive a copy of the proof with your changes tracked via email for your own records.
  • Upon submission of your corrections, you will be asked to complete a short survey on this proofing tool, the results of which will be used to inform future improvements. We appreciate your feedback.
    • If you require any assistance with IMPACT, please review the FAQs and User Guide here or contact our support team at impact.helpdesk@newgen.co

oup.welcome_heading: Welcome to IMPACT, the online proofing tool that permits authors to directly edit and collaborate on journal content for Oxford University Press.
oup.instructions_body:
1. Proof for Review: To access the article proof click “Agree and Continue” below.
  2. Respond to Queries: Ensure all copyeditor’s queries are addressed via “Queries” (left panel), or AQ symbols in the Editor View (centre panel).
  3. Edit Proof: Make all required corrections to your article in the Editor View (centre panel).
  4. Proof for Layout: Review the typeset proof layout (right panel) and instruct any layout-related corrections as comments in the Editor View (centre panel).
  5. Finalize: To approve the proof and proceed with the article’s publication select “Finalize” (top-right).

Notes

  • The images displayed in the Editor View are low resolution to optimise the performance of the tool. Please view the typeset proof layout to view images in high resolution.
  • The comment functionality allows you to provide instruction to the production editor or typesetting team to include the ability to supply files as attachments.
  • Post finalisation you will:
    • Receive a copy of the proof with your changes tracked via email for your own records.
    • Be requested to complete a short survey on the proofing tool, the results of which will be used to inform future improvements.
  • For the smooth operation of our system, we recommend an internet connection speed of at least 10mbps.

    If you need assistance with IMPACT, please review the Guided Tour, FAQs, User Guide, and Video Tutorial here, or contact our support team at impact.notification@newgen.co
oup.disclaimer_second_para:
For further information, please see our online advice at

https://academic.oup.com/pages/authoring/journals/production_and_publication/online_licensing

Third Party Plug-Ins:

Using any third-party plug-in to translate the content or make any changes in the editor is not recommended as it might affect the content quality and the underlying metadata, which will delay publication.

Chinese Version:
